text.description_html:
LCN 4040XPT Track Arm Door Closer "Super Smoothee"

The LCN 4040XP heavy duty track closer designed for commercial, institutional and other high traffic applications.

Closer mounts pull side on door, pull side top jamb or push side on door. The LCN 4040XPT is UL - and ULC-listed for self-closing doors.

Tested and certified under ANSI Standard A156.4 Grade One. LCN's most flexible heavy duty closer, non-sized cylinder for interior doors up to 4'. This LCN 4040XP closer is shipped with standard arm, standard track, track roller, standard plastic cover, and self reaming and tapping screws.

Also available: LCN 4040XP with standard arms

Features and Specifications of The LCN 4040XPT Track Door Closer

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable back check
  • Maximum Door Size: 48" Interior
  • Maximum Opening: 120º
  • Spring Tension: Adjustable 1-4
  • LCN "Green Dial" Spring Force Indicator
  • Non Handed
  • Certified Grade 1 for 10 Million Cycles
  • Cast Iron Housing
  • Forged Steel Arm with Aluminum Track
  • Double Heat Treated Steel Pinion
  • All Weather Fluid
  • UL & cUL Listed
  • 30 Year Warranty
  • ADA Compliant
  • Aluminum Finish
  • LCN 4040XPT Information (PDF)

    • Aluminum Finish. Packaged complete with standard arm, standard track, track roller, standard plastic cover, and self reaming and tapping screws.
